spans.s: ठक् a very common tad. affix इक, or क in case it is added to words ending in इस् , उस् , उ, ऋ, ल् and त् according to

, causing the substitution of vrddhi for the first vowel of the word to which it is added. ठक् is added to (1) रेवती and other words in the sense of descendant ( अपत्य ) e. g. रैवतिकः:, दाण्डग्राहिकः, गार्गिकः, भागवित्तिकः यामुन्दायनिकः, cf.
-149; (2) to the words लाक्षा,रोचना etc. in the sense of 'dyed in', e. g. लाक्षिकम्, रौचनिकम् ; cf.
; (3) to the words दधि and उदश्वित् in the sense of संस्कृत 'made better ', e. g. दाधिकम् , औदश्वित्कम् ( क instead of इक substituted for टक् ), cf.
, 19; (4) to the words अाग्रहायुणी, अश्वत्थ etc.; cf.
, 23; (5) to words expressive of inanimate objects, to the words हस्ति and धेनु, as also to the words केश and अश्व in the sense of 'multitude '; cf.
, 48; (6) to the words क्रतु, उक्थ and words ending in सूत्र, वसन्त etc., in the sense of 'students of' ( तदधीते तद्वेद ), cf.
, 60, 63; (7) to the words कुमुद and others as also to शर्करा as a चातुरर्थिक affix; cf.
, 84; (8) to the words कन्था, भवत् and वर्षा in the Saisika senses; cf.
; (9) to the words उपजानु and others in the sense 'generally present '; cf.
; (10) to the words consisting of two syllables, and the words ऋक्, ब्राह्मण etc.in the sense of 'explanatory literary work'; cf.
: ( 11) to words meaning 'sources of in- come ' in the sense of 'accruing from’; cf.
; (12) to words denoting inanimate things excepting words showing time or place in the sense of ' भक्ति ', cf
; and (13) to the words हल् and सीर in the sense of 'belong- ing to', cf.
. The tad. affix ठक् is added as a general termination, excepting in such cases where other affixes are pre- scribed, in specified senses like 'तेन दीव्यति, ' 'तेन खनति,' 'तेन संस्कृतम्' etc.; cf
-75, as also to words हल, सीर, कथा, विकथा, वितण्डा etc. in specified senses, cf.
, 102 ठक् is also added as a general tad. affix or अधिकारविहितप्रत्यय, in various specified senses, as pre- scribed by
-63,and to the words उदर, अयःशूल,दण्ड, अजिन, अङ्गुली, मण्डल, etc. and to the word एकशाला, in the prescribed senses; cf.

; while, with- out making any change in sense it is added to अनुगादिन् , विनय, समय, उपाय ( औपयिक being the word formed), अकस्मात्, कथंचित्; (cf.आकस्मिक काथंचित्क), समूह,विशेष, अत्यय and others, and to the word वाक् in the sense of 'expressed'; cf.
, 34, 35. The fem. affix ङीप् ( ई ) is added to words ending in the affix टक् to form fem. bases.
ठक्पाद a popular name given to the fourth pada of the fourth adhyaya of Panini's Astadhyayi.The pada be- gins with the rule प्राग्वहतेष्ठक्
prescribing the taddhita affix ठक् in the senses prescribed in rules be- . ginning with the next rule ' तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम् ' and ending with the rule 'निकटे वसति'
